release.title: Manzanita Works · Essential Capacity
release.subtitle: Capacity Commons Ledger
release.purpose: Prove one offer-to-fulfilled-need chain across time, tools, pilotage, projects, credits, evidence, and authority without making an external platform canonical.

authority_boundary.local_runtime: May prepare, record, validate, export, and replay local capacity events.
external_effects_withheld: No credit is recognized outside the local packet
authority_boundary.release_condition: A named Manzanita Works steward must accept the specific external act in the authoritative source system.

seats.label: Member
seats.function: Publish a need or offer and request redemption.

seats.label: Contributor
seats.function: Commit capacity and record what was actually provided.

seats.label: Pilot / Navigator
seats.function: Provide bounded hand-holding without replacing the domain professional.

seats.label: Steward / Operator
seats.function: Accept evidence, reconcile external references, and issue credits under policy.

seats.label: Successor / Auditor
seats.function: Reconstruct the case, verify receipts, and carry the packet forward.

capacity_classes.label: Pilotage
capacity_classes.accounting: bounded navigation event and destination receipt

capacity_classes.label: Mobility
capacity_classes.accounting: custody, route, or completed transport event

capacity_classes.label: Money
capacity_classes.accounting: processor receipt or authorized offline record
capacity_classes.boundary: Money is one capacity rail and does not define the commons.

projects.label: Essential Time pilot
projects.purpose: Test collective contribution, acceptance, credit, and pilotage redemption.

projects.label: E-bike workshop
projects.purpose: Place the mobility project inside the same tool, time, skill, and space substrate.
projects.authority: Project steward plus physical-custody source system

intents.description: Two hours of facilitation for a public-safe e-bike workshop rehearsal.
Contributor 01 can facilitate the workshop for two hours.
One torque-wrench use is needed for the workshop.
Essential Tools may supply the tool if MyTurn confirms custody and availability.
Pilot 01 can provide one hour of bounded service navigation.

events.note: The rehearsal cartridge was admitted. No exchange or external effect occurred.

unit.label: Essential Minute
unit.basis: one accepted minute of eligible contribution
unit.statement: Participation accounting, not cash, wages, legal tender, or an investment.

evidence.description: Synthetic actors and bounded events demonstrate the model without publishing member data.
The commons may retain an external MyTurn identifier or import receipt, but does not claim a checkout occurred without the MyTurn record.

policies.rule: Contribution and redemption need not close between the same two people.
policies.control: Credits are issued only after an accepted event and may be redeemed from the collective pool under policy.

policies.rule: An intent or commitment is not a completed contribution.
policies.control: No Essential Minutes are issued before a steward accepts a performed event.
MyTurn, payment processors, fundraising systems, and later components are referenced through adapter records; the canonical cross-domain relationships remain portable.

policies.rule: Participation data may support access, scheduling, recognition, safety, and continuity.
policies.control: It may not silently become punitive scoring, eligibility denial, employment screening, insurance action, or unrelated reputation ranking.

policies.rule: Victim-service and other sensitive needs are not public dashboard material.
policies.control: The public release uses synthetic records. Real sensitive cases require private custody, minimum disclosure, and role-specific access.

policies.rule: Credits do not excuse wage, licensing, safeguarding, or professional-duty requirements.
policies.control: A steward must classify the activity as eligible before credit issuance; legally compensable or licensed work remains subject to its governing rules.
